01 // RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT

Reflected waves,
clearer insights.

Phasor Diagnostics is building a low-cost millimeter-wave reflectometry system. By screening skin lesions with reflected radio signals instead of visible light, ultrasound, or biopsy, we are shaping the future of non-invasive diagnostics.

02 // The Core Thesis

Moving past the limits of optical inspection and physical incisions.

Skin diagnostics have relied on visual appearance or invasive biopsies for decades. By leveraging millimeter-wave reflectometry, Phasor unlocks a layer of data that standard eyes and cameras cannot see.

01 / SAFETY

Entirely Non-Invasive

No cutting, no scarring, and zero patient anxiety. Safe electromagnetic waves interact natively with localized tissue architecture.

02 / PHYSICS

Reflectometry Mapping

Different structural anomalies create distinct dielectric responses. Our system reads those reflections instantly to evaluate tissue composition.

03 / ACCESS

Low-Cost & Portable

Designed from day one to be affordable and compact, making high-end early screening viable for everyday clinical workflows worldwide.
